# Companion to `mutation-proofs.tsv` (FROZEN) and to the wave-6 files. Thirteen row-level proofs for
# the guards added to `reference-impl/tests/test_hero.py` and `reference-impl/tests/test_landforms.py`
# in the wave that replaces `tools/regen_figures.py`'s pixel-identity gate with invariants.
# WHY THE LANE EXISTS. The pixel gate compares committed PNGs to rebuilds byte-for-byte, and CI
# disproved its premise: runs 20 and 21 of the same workflow, on identical numpy 2.4.6 / pillow
# 12.3.0 / CPython 3.11.16 / ubuntu-latest, disagreed — `landforms` by 145469 pixels, the largest
# drift of the five — because numpy 2.x dispatches SIMD kernels per-CPU, floating-point addition is
# not associative, and the iterative erosion and flow loops amplify a last-bit difference into a
# visibly different field. So whatever the pixels were implicitly covering has to become an explicit
# assertion, and the assertion has to be one that survives a change of kernel.
# WHAT THE TWO FIGURES HAD IN COMMON. Both had well-guarded PRIMITIVES and an unguarded COMPOSITION.
#   * `hero`: tests/test_hero.py ran the rasteriser at 40x40 and 220x150 on an `archetypes.alpine`
#     tile. The figure runs `from_graph(seed=4)` -> streampower -> substances -> snowmelt ->
#     `shallow_water.simulate(iters=1400)` -> `hydrology.water_surface` -> `hero(n=180)`. `main()`
#     even computed the mass-balance identity `rain_in == out + stored`, PRINTED it, and returned
#     nothing.
#   * `landforms`: tests/test_landforms.py had 18 tests on the primitives and none on the montage —
#     in particular none at any resolution on the bottom-left droplet+thermal panel.
# THE FIX FOLLOWS THE PATTERN ALREADY IN THE TREE, not a new one: `crater_anatomy.build() ->
# (canvas, facts)`, `flow_anatomy.measurements()`, `halfar_anatomy.measurements()`,
# `gallery._REPORT`/`_track()`. `hero.scene()` and `landforms._montage()` now RETURN what `main()`
# used to print, so a guard re-runs the composition instead of re-deriving it from pixels.
# WHAT IS DELIBERATELY LEFT UNGUARDED, declared rather than faked:
#   * `hero`'s relief and peak discharge, and `landforms`' absolute relief/roughness values. These
#     are the quantities that MOVED between the two CI runs (archetypes' pit storage 5.22e+06 ->
#     4.16e+06 m3; Monument Valley relief 259 -> 268 m). A band around them would be a golden value
#     wearing an invariant's clothes, so no row pins one.
#   * A SCALE SLIP in the montage's thermal call — `thermal_erosion(hd, 0.7, 14, cell, ...)` losing
#     its `cell` argument and falling back to cellsize=1.0 — conserves mass and preserves every
#     ordering asserted here, so it passes all thirteen rows. Bounding it would need a roughness
#     band, and no band derived from measurement separates it from a legitimate retuning of
#     `factor` or `iters`. MEASURED, not assumed: applying that slip and running the whole file
#     gives `25 passed in 18.23s`. Recorded as a KNOWN GAP, not papered over.
# TOLERANCES. Two rows state a numeric band; both are derived in a comment beside the assertion and
# neither was widened to make a run pass:
#   * hero budget closure, tol 1e-9: measured 4.2e-15 .. 2.9e-14 over seeds 1-5 at (n=72, iters=400)
#     and (n=72, iters=1400) plus the shipped (n=180, iters=1400). ~4.5 decades above the float64
#     floor, ~5 decades below the smallest defect the identity can express (the boundary term is
#     12-29% of rain_in). It is two orders TIGHTER than the 1e-6 tests/test_shallow_water.py:34
#     already uses for the same budget.
#   * montage volume closure, tol 1e-9: measured 0.0 .. 3.4e-16 at n = 48, 56, 64, 72, 96, 200 —
#     one or two ulps on a sum of n^2 heights. ~6.5 decades of headroom.
# Every other row is a conservation law, a sign, an ordering or an exact geometric identity, and
# needs no tolerance at all.
# PROTOCOL. Mutations are applied to the SUBJECT module (never the test), `__pycache__` is cleared
# before and after every trial (this repo has hit a false RED from CPython's mtime-seconds/size .pyc
# validation on a byte-length-identical mutation reverted inside one second), the failing test id
# and first failure line below are pasted from the real run, and every file is verified
# byte-identical by sha256 after revert. Verified subject modules touched and restored:
# hero.py, landforms.py, shallow_water.py, hydrology.py, erosion_droplet.py.
# COST. Both guard sets build their composition ONCE at reduced size and share it via
# functools.lru_cache: hero at n=72/iters=400 (~2 s, vs ~14 s for the physics at the shipped
# n=180/iters=1400) and landforms at n=64 with the cell size scaled so the 5.2 km extent is the
# figure's (~5 s, vs ~12 s for the droplet solver alone at n=200). Every invariant asserted is a
# conservation law, a sign or an ordering, none of which is a function of resolution, and each was
# re-measured at the shipped size to confirm it still holds there. Suite cost: test_hero.py 7 passed
# in 4.56s, test_landforms.py 25 passed in 17.99s.
